## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger and the resulting behavior. Link the issue and apply type/area labels.

## Evidence

List exact checks and results, including any skipped tests or unavailable external services.
Update docs/VALIDATION.md or the relevant operating documentation where behavior changes.

## Trust boundaries and limits

Identify changed authentication, data exposure, grants, consent, network or persistence
behavior. State prototype limitations honestly. Preserve historical migrations and references.

- [ ] Commits are signed and GitHub-verified.
